Career Journey

M. Enayetur Rahman began his career in 1983 as an Assistant Engineer (Mech) with the Bangladesh Water Development Board. He went on to serve the Government of Bangladesh for more than three decades, including the Bangladesh Ordnance Factories Board, the Department of Industries and the Board of Investment, where he moved from Deputy Director (Operations) to Director (Investment Promotion). After serving as PPP Specialist with LGED’s City Regions Development Project (2013–14), he has been CEO and Partner of EME Consultants & Engineers in Dhaka since 2015. His professional training included the Japan-Singapore Partnership Training Programme on Mechatronics System Technology in Singapore (1996).

Key Contributions
  • Closely engaged for the last 40 years in counselling, policy and strategy formulation and implementation of investment promotion and regulatory services delivery for domestic and foreign direct investment in Bangladesh.
  • Built wide experience through training programs, executive studies, seminars, symposia and workshops at home and abroad, including India, Japan, Singapore, Malaysia, South Korea, China, Australia and the UK.
  • Resource person for a number of training programs, seminars, workshops and symposia on FDI and PPPs, at home and abroad.
  • Team Leader for a number of market, pre-feasibility and feasibility studies and reports for private-sector investment across industrial product and service sectors.
  • Prepared PPP training modules for capacity building of local government bodies in Bangladesh.
